subject: Renewal scope & capacity — order form and MSA clarifications
messages:
From: Celia Ramos <celia.ramos@bluelumen.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@bluelumen.io>, BlueLumen Legal <legal@bluelumen.io>
Date: 2028-03-11T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal plan + capacity bump questions

Hi Soojin,

We are starting our internal procurement cycle for the April renewal. Two items to flag up front: (1) we want to add a short-term burst capacity line for Q2 to support a new feature launch (approx. +150M tokens over 3 months), and (2) we need the contract term to align to our fiscal year end (July 31).

Attached is our preferred order form spreadsheet with the proposed quantities. Can your legal team confirm whether the MSA language on termination for convenience and the SLA credit caps can accommodate the term shift? Also, we saw an internal note about data residency — we need confirmation that logs for BlueLumen remain in us-east for the next 12 months.

Celia
Director of Platform Engineering
BlueLumen

Attachments: BL-OrderForm_v3.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Celia Ramos <celia.ramos@bluelumen.io>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal plan + capacity bump questions

Thanks Celia — this is timely. Quick summary of next steps from our side: 
- I will loop in Legal (Markus) to comment on the proposed term shift and SLA cap changes.
- Aditya (solution engineering) will validate the burst capacity delta and propose a pricing addendum for a 3-month burst.
- Neha (CS) will prepare a mutual action plan and internal kickoff for procurement.

Markus — attaching the customer's order form. Please flag any non-starter clauses; BlueLumen is asking for (a) termination date aligned to 31-Jul-2029, and (b) an increase to SLA credits if they exceed X% of monthly spend for sustained incidents. Also: confirm we can commit to us-east residency for logs for 12 months (we have a Private tenancy option but want to confirm hosted guarantees).

Celia — we aim to get legal comments back by EOD Tuesday if possible. If you prefer, we can run a short 30-minute call to walk redlines.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0194

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Celia Ramos <celia.ramos@bluelumen.io>, BlueLumen Legal <legal@bluelumen.io>
Date: 2028-03-12T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal plan + capacity bump questions — initial legal notes

Soojin / team — initial read below, high-level and not a complete redline: 

1) Term alignment: We can accommodate a contract term that ends 2029-07-31. We'll prepare a short addendum to the MSA to reflect a non-standard term boundary; no major issue from a business perspective.

2) Termination for convenience (Section 7): BlueLumen's proposed language removes the 30-day cure window; that is a material change. Recommend we preserve a 30-day cure period, but propose shortening dispute escalation timelines to 15 days to address BlueLumen's procurement timeline.

3) SLA credit caps (Section 4.3): Customer requests uncapped credits beyond X% for sustained incidents. We can increase the cap for this order form only (one-time exception) up to 40% of monthly invoice for repeat incidents, provided we add failover/mitigation obligations and a 6-month cadence for post-incident reviews. Drafted proposed text and consolidated into a tracked copy attached: Redwood_MSA_2028_trackchanges.pdf

4) Data residency: We can confirm logs retained in us-east for 12 months for hosted customers as a contractual assurance. However, tight language around access and export needs to be scoped; I'll add an Exhibit describing residency controls.

5) Burst capacity: Operationally fine; we'll need the order form to include a burst addendum with pricing and a maximum threshold. Aditya, please provide the acceptable throughput change and whether pre-warming is needed.

I'll convert these into a redline and return by tomorrow EOD.

--
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_2028_trackchanges.pdf

From: Celia Ramos <celia.ramos@bluelumen.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@bluelumen.io>, BlueLumen Legal <legal@bluelumen.io>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-12T13:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal plan + capacity bump questions — initial legal notes

Thanks Markus — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:
- Cure window: we can accept a modified cure window (15 days) provided the termination for convenience advance notice shortens to 30 days.
- SLA credits: the 40% cap is reasonable as a one-time concession if BlueLumen can obtain monthly credits greater than 25% for two consecutive months only with demonstrable metrics. We'll add our suggested metrics to the order form.
- Data residency exhibit: request that the exhibit include a high-level operational runbook for log export within 24 hours on request for audits.

We're happy to take a 30 minute call tomorrow morning to resolve these items and get to a signing-ready package; let us know times.

Celia

> > Soojin / team — initial read below, high-level and not a complete redline:
> >

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Celia Ramos <celia.ramos@bluelumen.io>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, BlueLumen Legal <legal@bluelumen.io>
Date: 2028-03-13T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal plan + capacity bump questions — next steps and signing path

Great progress team — summary and action items: 

1) Legal redline: Markus to send the tracked MSA redline + Exhibit-B draft (data residency + log export) by 2028-03-14 11:00 PT.
2) Ops & pricing: Aditya to publish a 3-month burst addendum with pre-warm options and the incremental rates by EOD 2028-03-14. Attach to the order form as BL-OrderForm_v4.
3) Mutual action plan / procurement: Neha to create an MAP doc and attach the HubSpot deal; target signing window: 2028-03-21 to 2028-03-23.
4) Call: Celia / Tom — proposed 30 minute call on 2028-03-14 at 09:00 PT. Please confirm.

Pending items for BlueLumen: confirm acceptance of 15 day cure window with 30 day termination notice; agreement to SLA cap exception (40% one-time) subject to post-incident review clause.

I'll circulate the consolidated package with a DocuSign envelope link when redlines and pricing are attached.

Thanks — speak soon.

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
